Privacy.title: How we handle your data
Privacy.intro: HSB Company ("HSB", "we") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law nº 13.709/2018 — LGPD). This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it, with whom we share it, and your rights as a data subject.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body:
Controller: HSB Company
Location: São Paulo, Brazil
Privacy contact: contato@hsb.company

dataCollected.title: 2. Data we collect
dataCollected.body:
We collect the following categories:

• Navigation data: pages visited, clicks, time per section, device, browser, language. Collected via PostHog (EU-hosted) only after your consent.

• Contact data voluntarily provided: name or company, email, phone, and goal description, when you fill the contact form or interact with our chatbot.

• We do not collect sensitive data (race, political views, health, etc.).

purposes.title: 3. Purposes
purposes.body:
We use your data to:

• Respond to your quote requests and contact.
• Understand aggregate visitor behavior and improve the site (heatmaps, funnels, conversion metrics).
• Comply with legal and regulatory obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.body:
• Consent (LGPD art. 7º, I) for analytics cookies and chatbot processing.
• Performance of contract or preliminary procedures (art. 7º, V) for the quote form.
• Legitimate interest (art. 7º, IX) for platform security and fraud prevention.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.body:
We use two types of cookies:

• Essential: required for the site to work (language, theme, chatbot session). No consent required.

• Analytics (PostHog): record interactions in pseudonymized form to understand site usage. Only enabled after you accept in the consent banner. You can revoke anytime by clearing your browser cookies.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.body:
• Contact form data: up to 24 months after last contact, unless a longer legal retention applies.
• Pseudonymized analytics data: up to 12 months.
• Chatbot messages: up to 90 days for service-improvement purposes.

sharing.title: 7. Sharing
sharing.body:
We share data only with strictly necessary processors, all preferably hosted in the European Union or under appropriate international transfer clauses:

• Vercel — site hosting.
• PostHog — aggregate behavior analytics and heatmaps (EU hosting — Frankfurt). Only active after consent.
• n8n — chatbot conversation orchestration (self-hosted server).
• Supabase — database storing leads and conversation history.
• Mistral AI — AI processing of chatbot conversations (EU hosting — Paris, France). Does not use your data for model training.
• Notion — internal record of qualified leads (restricted access to HSB team).
• Email provider (SMTP) — internal alerts when a lead is qualified.

We do not sell or share data for third-party marketing.

security.title: 8. Security
security.body: We adopt reasonable technical and administrative measures: encryption in transit (HTTPS), role-based access control, rate limiting and audit logs. No system is 100% immune; in case of a relevant incident, we will notify ANPD and affected subjects as required by LGPD.

rights.title: 9. Your rights as a data subject
rights.body:
You may, at any time, request:

• Confirmation of processing
• Access to your data
• Correction of incomplete or incorrect data
• Anonymization, blocking or deletion
• Portability
• Deletion of data processed under your consent
• Withdrawal of consent

To exercise, email contato@hsb.company with subject "LGPD - Data Subject Right". We will respond within 15 days.

contact.title: 10. Contact and updates
contact.body:
This policy may be updated periodically. The last revision date appears at the top. For questions, complaints, or reports, contact us at contato@hsb.company.

You also have the right to file a complaint with Brazil's data protection authority (ANPD).
